iconicAnchor.label: Memphis Group furniture and interiors
iconicAnchor.creatorOrTradition: Memphis Group, founded by Ettore Sottsass
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: The group's objects establish Memphis as an irreverent postmodern collision of furniture, laminate, unstable geometry, pattern, and deliberately discordant color—not a generic squiggle pattern.

sources.title: Memphis
supports: Memphis rejected restrained good taste through asymmetrical forms, plastic laminates, bold patterns, clashing colors, and references to popular culture.

sources.title: Ettore Sottsass
supports: Sottsass's furniture and objects demonstrate the movement's object-scale composition, symbolic form, material artificiality, and challenge to functionalist neutrality.

bundledReferenceRationale: Excellent single-image set. The lead clearly teaches geometric, vivid chroma, patterned, playful, retains its identity at card scale, and shows no visible anti-cue, integrity failure, or confusing overlap with neighboring styles. The independently approved lead is assets/refs/memphis-design/generated-lead.jpg. No support image is needed because the lead carries the direction without filler.
